description: Validate complete ingestion pipeline works correctly
steps: Run all 4 ingestion commands manually and verify S3 output
Verify Polymarket trades ingestion produces valid Bronze output
Verify Polymarket markets ingestion produces valid Bronze output
Verify Kalshi trades ingestion produces valid Bronze output
Verify Kalshi markets ingestion produces valid Bronze output
Validate all manifests contain accurate metadata

description: Verify EventBridge scheduled runs work correctly
steps: Wait for at least one scheduled run of each job type
Verify ECS tasks complete successfully (exit code 0)
Verify CloudWatch logs show expected output
Verify S3 data is written with correct key structure
Verify manifests are generated for each run
Confirm run_ids are unique across runs
Execute manual backfill for Polymarket trades for a past date
Execute manual backfill for Kalshi trades for a past date
Verify backfill creates new run_id (no overwrite)
Verify backfill data lands in correct S3 path
Verify manifest is created for backfill run
Document backfill procedure for operators

description: Test failure scenarios and recovery procedures
steps: Simulate API failure and verify retry behavior
Simulate network timeout and verify graceful handling
Verify failed runs produce non-zero exit codes
Verify failed runs are visible in CloudWatch logs
Test that retries create new run_ids (no data corruption)
Document failure recovery procedures

description: Verify all Release 1 exit criteria are met
steps: Confirm S3 Bronze bucket exists with versioning enabled
Confirm Polymarket trades/markets ingestion runs on schedule
Confirm Kalshi trades/markets ingestion runs on schedule
Confirm each run writes part-000.jsonl.gz and manifest.json
Confirm ingestion is restart-safe (no overwrites, no mutable state)
Confirm backfills work via same ECS task definitions
Confirm CloudWatch logs show successful, observable runs
Confirm no Silver/Gold assumptions exist in Bronze code

description: Create operational documentation for MVP handoff
steps: Create OPERATIONS.md runbook with common procedures
Document how to trigger manual backfills
Document how to check run status and logs
Document how to troubleshoot common failures
Document AWS resource inventory (buckets, roles, schedules)
Update README with project overview and quick start
Ensure all schedules are enabled in production
Verify alerting is configured and tested
Confirm at least 24 hours of successful scheduled runs
Get stakeholder sign-off on Release 1 completion
Archive any temporary test data
Tag release in version control as v1.0.0-bronze
